cover.headline: Baugh Control: No. 24 Florida rallies past Vanderbilt 34-27 on Senior Day
cover.dek: Jadan Baugh's 10-yard touchdown run with 2:18 left finished Florida's comeback from a 24-17 halftime deficit. The Gators outscored Vanderbilt 17-3 after halftime.
cover.byline: By GatorBait Staff · Photos by Chris Spears

damage.title: 17-3 after halftime
damage.dek: Florida trailed 24-17 at the half and gave up one field goal the rest of the way. The Gators finished with 411 yards to Vanderbilt's 378 and converted 11 of 16 third downs.

stats.label: Aaron Philo passing yards
stats.detail: 20 of 26 passing, plus 73 rushing yards and two touchdowns.

stats.label: Yards on Myles Graham's fumble return
stats.detail: The touchdown put Florida ahead 17-9. Graham also had 10 tackles.

stats.label: Jadan Baugh's season rushing yards
stats.detail: 76 on Saturday. He needs 19 at Florida State for 1,000.

stats.label: Florida penalties
stats.detail: Six for 37 yards in the first half. Vanderbilt: 3-20.

scoring.title: How the points came
scoring.dek: Vanderbilt led 24-17 at halftime after scoring 15 points in the final 1:46 of the second quarter. Florida scored the next 10, Vanderbilt tied it at 27 with 5:52 left, and Jadan Baugh scored with 2:18 to play.

flow.title: How the lead changed hands
flow.dek: Florida's chance to win, play by play. The Gators started at 84%, were at 55% at halftime and fell as low as 46% in the third quarter before the comeback.

marks.note: Myles Graham's 57-yard fumble return with 5:27 left in the half; Florida is at 90%
Jared Curtis hits Junior Sherrill for 75 yards with 39 seconds left in the half; Florida is at 56%
Aaron Philo scores from the 1 with 4:07 left in the third quarter; Florida is at 70%
Patrick Durkin's 20-yard field goal with 8:27 to play; Florida is at 78%
Brock Taylor's 51-yard field goal with 5:52 left; Florida is at 68%
Jadan Baugh's 10-yard run with 2:18 left; Florida is at 95%

flow.summary: Line chart of Florida's win probability against Vanderbilt. It starts near 84%, is at 55% at halftime, falls as low as 46% in the third quarter and ends at 100% after Jadan Baugh's touchdown with 2:18 left and a fourth-down sack with 30 seconds left.
flow.source: Win probability: ESPN. GatorBait Media graphic.

next.title: Florida at Florida State
next.note: Florida is 7-4 overall and 5-4 in the SEC. The trip to Tallahassee closes the regular season.

pickem.title: Baugh at 981
pickem.text: Jadan Baugh ran for 76 yards and the winning touchdown against Vanderbilt. He has 981 for the season and needs 19 at Florida State to reach 1,000.
